name: recoil
text: A standing person suddenly recoils in shock from something directly in front. Pull the head and upper body sharply backward, throw both hands up protectively in front of the chest, and take two quick stumbling steps backward to regain balance. End with weight back and hands still raised defensively.

review.notes_zh: 起始已抬手护脸，随后头胸猛向后缩并连退恢复平衡，水平后撤约0.81米；幅度大于单纯原地受惊。
